left.raw_text:
Inclusion Criteria:
  -  Body mass index (BMI) equal or greater than 35 kg/m2

right.raw_text: -  American Society of Anesthesiologists (ASA) physical status I - III patients

left.raw_text: -  Scheduled to undergo laparoscopic roux-en-Y gastric bypass  [OR] or gastric sleeve placement surgery for weight loss

right.raw_text:
Exclusion Criteria:
  -  Chronic obstructive pulmonary disorder (COPD)

left.raw_text: -  Treatment with continuous positive airway pressure (CPAP) in the past three months

right.raw_text: -  Severe neurological, [OR]  cardiopulmonary, [OR]  psychiatric, [OR]  or untreated thyroid disorder

left.raw_text: -  Chronic pain condition that was being treated with opioids

right.raw_text: -  Patients with a hematocrit lower than 35%
